title: OpenAPI SDK subscriptions:list
means: List Subscriptions. Both SDK spellings issue the same first-page wire request.

spellings.source:
from polar.v2026_04 import Polar

polar = Polar("polar_oat_xxx")

for item in polar.subscriptions.iter_list(
    page=1,
    limit=10,
    sorting=['-started_at'],
):
    print(item)

    aggregation={'func': 'count'},
)
